title: Explicit12.175 remainder at every integer input length

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic-field family defined by proof.md and family.py. At actual length N enumerate primes2<=k<=N, r=ceil(N/k) and r-1 with r>=3,k>r+1, m=min(N,rk), ignored p=N-m, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Sections12--13, B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m, and choose the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,p) including the zero option(4N,0,0,0). Construct Q_k by the supplied deterministic prime-degree specialization of Shoup in field.md and irreducible_prime(k), ignore p actual input bits, and evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits over F2[Z]/Q_k with zero padding. No field-polynomial bits or advice are inputs.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This one fixed total language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. The supplied binary linear-algebra/cyclotomic/trace algorithm constructs a deterministic irreducible degree-k polynomial for every selected odd prime k without an external oracle. The PRIME-DEGREE zero-deficit field theorem gives degree>=B on every dimension-d affine payload space; the retained full-B2 theorem gives4m-8d+4B+3. Thus C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N at every actual integer N. Optimizing ignored prefixes0<=p<=k requires only the two block counts and never exceeds the retained paid/compressed reference losses when present. Every sufficiently large integer N has L_N=O(N^(4/5))=o(N), so for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon with C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N for every integer N>=N_epsilon in the full Li-Yang B2 model. For EVERY integer N>=0 this same fixed family also satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(25/2)N^(4/5). proof.md Sections8--9 provide an explicit Bertrand-based tail for N>=2^18 and a fully checked finite interval certificate for the remaining range; no sharp-constant theorem or accepted-result catalog is a premise. Moreover, for EVERY integer N>=0 the same fixed family satisfies the stronger C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(609/50)N^(4/5). proof.md Sections10--11 give a refined Bertrand-based analytic tail N>=2^30 and an independently checked deterministic finite interval generator covering262<=N<2^30; the zero option covers0..261. The generated finite certificate is reproduced by the declared experiment, and concavity covers its interiors. The same family further satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(487/40)N^(4/5) for EVERY integer N>=0: proof.md Section12 supplies the analytic tail N>=2^36, zero-option range0..261, and a reproduced32845-row finite cover of262..2^36-1 with exact endpoint verification and concavity.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: For every ODD PRIME k>=3, the exact irreducible_prime(k) algorithm in family.py terminates in polynomial time in k and outputs a monic irreducible binary polynomial of degree k. field.md supplies the complete prime-degree construction and proof, including binary factor extraction, cyclotomic nonresidue lifting, Kummer extension and trace descent. This specializes a known Shoup construction and does not claim a new general irreducible-construction algorithm.

The complete finite certified losses(original,weighted,positive-exact,zero-deficit,compressed,new) are(1461,1437,1429,1413,1393,1257) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485,2485,2465,2265) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433,4417,4397,4061) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577,16521,16501,15365) at N=10000. These compare certified losses, not actual optimal circuit sizes.

For EVERY integer actual N>=0, this fixed total uniform P family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(25/2)N^(4/5). proof.md Sections8--9 supply the Bertrand-based analytic tail and concavity argument, while audit.py gives and checks the literal 220-interval certificate covering299..262143 with440 exact endpoint inequalities. The zero option covers0..298. No infinite-range claim is inferred from untested finite samples.

For EVERY integer actual length N>=0, this unchanged fixed total uniform P family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(609/50)N^(4/5). proof.md Sections10--11 supply the refined Bertrand tail and concavity/coverage proof. The declared bounded computation generates and independently checks the complete finite certificate for262..2^30-1; it does not extrapolate samples to an untested infinite range.

For EVERY integer actual length N>=0 this same fixed total uniform P family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(487/40)N^(4/5). proof.md Section12 supplies the analytic tail N>=2^36 and zero-option range0..261. The declared computation generates and independently verifies the complete finite32845-row cover of262..2^36-1; the supplied selector-inclusion and concavity proofs establish all interval interiors.

experiments.purpose: Generate and independently verify the stronger finite interval cover for262..2^30-1 with exact primality/admissibility/consecutive-coverage and integer endpoint predicates, verify rational analytic constants, and retain the prior220-row cover plus bounded field/threshold/reference/evaluator checks. Concavity and the infinite analytic tail are supplied in proof.md. Also generate and independently verify the32845-row stronger cover through2^36-1 and its rational tail constants.
